source_evidence: Player exact '**The defense of Caereth** seems like something we can look into while we are here' expresses interest, not acceptance of contract or combat. In same guild courtyard, organizer voluntarily gives details consistent with prepared OR-CR-CA packet, including private defense personnel claiming emergency authority over armory, disputed authorization, upcoming public guild meeting set for late afternoon D315, ordinary option to consult records/quartermaster first, guild terms 833gp civilian safety and functioning meeting,1667gp remainder ending coercive hold, maximum2500gp. No secret fixed roster revealed, no automatic assumption of guilt or national political settlement, no commitment of houses or V to contract. Elara supports inquiry not private seizure or automatic opposition to strengthening defense. Approximately15min elapsed. No uncertain check, no expenditure. D314~19:15 Caereth chartered-guild courtyard. V expresses interest in the Defense of Caereth, actual conversation with the district organizer, no contract accepted. Organizer explains concern about private defense personnel trying to take control of guild armory under claimed emergency powers; assembly authorization disputed, not adjudicated. Public guild meeting planned D315 late afternoon; organizer requests independent protection of attendees, preservation of lawful access and end to any coercive control. Guilds reserve total2500gp:833gp for safe civilians and functioning meeting,1667gp remainder for ending coercive hold; no payment, political vote or forced combat. Organizer can arrange access to relevant guild records and quartermaster before meeting, no records examined yet, no hostile roster or hidden evidence revealed. Elara independently supports investigating legality while respecting genuine defense needs; no House Rethwyn commitment. V may agree to meet organizer tomorrow subject to palace appointment, ask more, or defer. Marriage recognized in Crownsunder; palace audience request pending, no appointment. V383gp4sp6cp food21/feed28, all party HP/resources full, attuned cloak+Luckstone, rest3/6, peryton specimens and Kestrel originals unchanged, Elara/Mara/4 horses healthy. No magic purchase, dinner or overnight yet. Dice delegated until stop.
